Slop Press · free, in your browser

Design a flyer to print or share

Posters for a gig, a club night, a sale or a lost cat: start from the Event flyer template, or a blank A4 or Letter page, and export a PDF for the printer or a PNG for social media.

Make a flyer

How to do it

  1. Choose File > New from Template… and pick Event flyer, or start from A4, A5, Letter or Tabloid.
  2. Edit the headline and details with the Type tool; set them with paragraph styles.
  3. Place a photo with File > Place… and choose how it fills its frame.
  4. Export PDF… for print, or Export PNG… at 72, 150 or 300 ppi to post online.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Press runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Which sizes can I use?

A3, A4, A5, A6, Letter, Half Letter, Legal and Tabloid, portrait or landscape, or any custom size in mm, inches or points.

Can I print it at home?

Yes. Print… sends it to your printer at its real size, or use the Digital / screen PDF preset without marks.

Are there many templates?

Five for now: Magazine spread, Event flyer, Business card, Zine and Blank A4. Everything else starts from a page size.
